name: Use Blender and Use After Effects (/use-blender, /use-after-effects)
makes: Setup commands: install and connect a local MCP server so a desktop client can drive Blender (.blend, background process) or Adobe After Effects on the user's own computer.

steps.name: Check Node, npm and the app

prompts.label: The setup request (Blender)
prompts.text: `higgsfield mcp, /use-blender` is a request to install and connect this integration. In local Codex or Claude Code (including Claude Desktop **Code → Local**), use the host shell to complete the installation, register the server for the current OS user, and verify it. The command itself authorizes these setup steps; use the latest supported published package and do not stop to ask whether to install or which registration scope. Honor any narrower scope or other constraint the user states.

prompts.label: The setup request (After Effects)
prompts.text: `higgsfield mcp, /use-after-effects` is a request to install and connect this integration. In local Codex or Claude Code (including Claude Desktop **Code → Local**), use the host shell to complete the installation, register the server for the current OS user, and verify it. The command itself authorizes these setup steps; use the latest published package and do not stop to ask whether to install, which version, or which registration scope. Honor any narrower scope or other constraint the user states.

prompts.label: Blender connection path
prompts.text: Desktop client → stdio → fnf-blender-mcp → process pipes → Blender Python / bpy.

prompts.label: After Effects connection path
prompts.text: Desktop MCP client → local Node MCP server → OS scripting / ExtendScript → After Effects.

price: No credits for setup. A rented GPU box for AE (Artcraft) is the only paid path and is not quoted here.
